source_title: An InventHelp 123Invent Client Develops Vehicle Window Screen Idea (TKI-1388)
source_excerpt:
PITTSBURGH , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- "I wanted to create a way to help keep flying insects from entering a vehicle while driving with the windows down," said an inventor from East Stroudsburg, Pa. "My idea would allow drivers and passengers to enjoy fresh air with added comfort and protection."
InventHelp Invention Spotlight: BLU MESH TECHNOLOGY Could Help Keep Insects Out of Vehicles
Helps keep flying insects from entering the vehicle
Provides added comfort for drivers, passengers, children and pets InventHelp Client's Invention for Vehicles
Driving with open windows can allow insects to enter the vehicle, which could cause discomfort, distraction or fear for passengers. The BLU MESH TECHNOLOGY idea would offer an integrated automotive ventilation accessory that could help users enjoy fresh air while limiting unwanted bugs.
Licensing Opportunities for InventHelp 123Invent Client:
The invention is available for licensing or sale to manufacturers or marketers who may wish to bring it to market.
For more information, visit www.blumeshtechnology.com . Or contact Amanda Davis at (272) 246-9617 or email [email protected] .
